rules.message: git push is not run by the agent. Leave the branch as it is and ask the user to push.
sed is not available here. Use perl for the same edit, e.g. perl -pi -e 's/old/new/g' file.
Files named .env hold credentials and are off limits. Ask the user for the value you need.
Heredocs are not used here. Write file contents with the Write or Edit tool, and for input a program reads, write the script to a file first and pass that file.
